fields.label: BASIN MECHANISM (what the session was sent to find)
fields.value: The damp has a knee at |m|/+0x9e4 = 0.7 (saturates at the 0.9 cap). The ORIGINAL is on that cap on 15 of 23 fixups (65.2%); the PORT on 0 of 211 (0.0%). The original's |cos(velocity, wall normal)| falls monotonically across its 10-contact post-bounce train (frames 978..1096) and escapes after a 158-frame gap; the port's rises and LOCKS on a fixed point at |cos| ~ 0.827, damp ~0.55, speed ~55 — exactly section 21.5's 40-70 residency band.
